description_en: Queries the information about all figures and faces in a specific figure library
description_zh: 列出指定⼈物库下的所有⼈物和⼈脸信息
kebab_example: aliyun mts list-custom-persons --category-id CategoryId-0000 --person-id PersonId-0000 --api-version 2014-06-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCustomPersons

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the figure library about which you want to query information. The ID is used to uniquely identify a custom figure library. Make sure that the ID is unique. If you do not specify this parameter, the operation returns all the custom figure libraries. The ID can be up to 120 characters in length and is not case-sensitive.

> You cannot specify the ID of the system figure library for this parameter.
parameters.description_zh:
⼈物库ID，⽤于唯⼀标识⼀个⾃定义⼈物库，由调⽤者⽣成，调⽤者⾃⼰保证唯⼀性。若不填写，将列出所有⾃定义⼈物库。最⻓⽀持120字符，不区分⼤⼩写

> 不能与系统⼈物库ID相同。
